scope: the KR daily loop on 069500 (KODEX 200) only; paper mode by default; live only after the owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel

capital.account: owner's Toss KR account cash plus the daily 10,000 won refill
capital.instrument: 069500 only; no other instrument is traded by this loop
capital.position: either all cash or all-in 069500 (integer shares affordable with fee); no leverage, no short, no derivatives

signal.rule: EMA ribbon 8 > 21 > 50 > 200 on adjusted closes (rule core 5e617d97): weight 1 when fully stacked, else 0
signal.decision_time: 15:35 KST on each trading session, only on a completed daily bar (fetched after 15:31); no decision when the bar is not complete by 15:40 (stale data)
signal.execution: next trading session 09:00:30..09:10 KST: market buy of the affordable integer quantity when weight 1 and not held; market sell of the whole holding when weight 0 and held; nothing otherwise
signal.evidence: retrospective ledger 2014-12-30..2026-11-05: +48,095,602 won (99.5% from 2025-2026), max drawdown -14,865,836, exposure 39%, TWR +200.9% (always-long +243.4%), unit drawdown -24.5% (always-long -42.9%); plateau and delay/cost stress passed; one same-data history, not a forward guarantee

limits.max_daily_loss: if the account value at any 15:35 check is below 97% of the previous session's close value, do not place new buys and post an alert (sell is still allowed by the rule)
kill_switch: stale data: no complete bar by 15:40 or no orderbook at execution -> no order, alert
order anomaly: rejected, cancelled or partial fill not resolved within 90 s -> pause the loop, alert
rule breach: any order outside 09:00:30..09:10 KST or on an instrument other than 069500 -> freeze the loop until the owner restarts it
drawdown: account value below 85% of its peak since the loop started -> flatten at the next open and pause until the owner restarts
limits.broker_side: where Toss allows, set an account-level daily order cap for 069500 equal to the loop's size; this is a wall, the loop's checks are only rules

records.ledger: runs/dobby_kr_ledger.jsonl append-only: every decision (EMAs, trend, weight), every execution (ask/bid, quantity, fee), every skip with reason, every alert
records.channel: one line per decision and per execution in #bigmoney; alerts immediately
records.weekly: every Sunday 18:00 KST: paper/live results vs the frozen backtest decisions for the same sessions (consistency check), posted to the channel

promotion_ladder.name: paper
promotion_ladder.condition_to_advance: 10 trading sessions logged with every decision matching the rule core applied to the stored bars (zero mismatches)

promotion_ladder.name: live
promotion_ladder.condition: owner writes DOBBY_LIVE=1 in the channel after rung 1 evidence is posted
promotion_ladder.capital: the account as is (small); no size ramp needed

promotion_ladder.name: review
promotion_ladder.condition: every Sunday; demote to paper on any kill-switch trigger or a rule-code change until the change is reviewed

change_control: the rule, its parameters and the limits change only by a new spec with hashes reviewed by bill; no parameter change after seeing live results without a written spec
not_covered: the research council axes (T, Fly, Jev) until they pass their own gates
